text:
Asha V: Quick sync — calibration week is coming and a few reviewers flagged conflicts. I want to publish a short contingency plan so we don't scramble. Thoughts?
Daniel R: Sounds good. Keep it lightweight. Two suggestions: an opt-in overflow pool and a 24h swap window for reviewers to trade slots.
Priya S: Agree. Also add a small cap per reviewer for overflow (default 5 extra forms) and let reviewers set "no overflow".
Asha V: Plan draft: (1) Publish volunteer overflow pool (opt-in), (2) Auto-assign backups from volunteers if reviewer misses their slot, (3) Default cap = 5 extra forms, reviewers can increase, (4) Escalation pool of 3 for LOA/new-hire/critical roles.
Daniel R: Love it. Can we add a short rubric for quick triage so backups can process a form in ~7 mins?
Priya S: Yes — include 3 bullets: check role/level, check prior feedback, flag any compensation/special-circumstance asks.
Asha V: I'll post. Juno, can you create the volunteer form and a calendar tag for "overflow-ready" reviewers?
Juno (HR Bot): Yep — volunteer form link ready: https://redwoodhq/reviews/volunteer. I can add an "overflow-ready" calendar tag and auto-fill backups from volunteers at 08:00 PT on calibration day.
Daniel R: One last ask: managers should pre-clear any flagged exceptions by EOD before calibration so escalation pool isn't overloaded.
Priya S: Also add an opt-out checkbox for reviewers who are close to comp cycles or heavy launches.
Asha V: Done. I'll publish the announcement in 30m unless there are objections. Short draft below:

```
Heads-up: contingency plan for reviewer coverage during calibration week.
- Action for reviewers: update the volunteer form (link) and set "overflow ok? Y/N" and max extra forms (default 5).
- If a reviewer misses a slot, backups will be auto-assigned from volunteers. Backups should use the 3-bullet triage rubric to keep throughput fast.
- Exceptions (LOA, critical hires, recent comp asks) will go to the escalation pool of on-call reviewers — managers must pre-clear these by EOD.
- Reviewers who cannot accept overflow: mark "no overflow" and we will not auto-assign you.
Questions? Reply here or DM @Asha V.
```
Asha V: Posting in 30. No objections so far.
Priya S: No objections.
Daniel R: Good to go.
